name: Taira
description: nice!nano 2基とKailh Choc v1で組む66キーの無線分割キーボード。公式ガイドが電池配線、Mill-Maxソケット、Bluetooth動作確認まで写真付きで追える。
descriptionEn: A 66-key wireless split keyboard built with two nice!nanos and Kailh Choc v1 switches. The official guide walks through battery wiring, Mill-Max socketing, and Bluetooth bring-up with detailed photos.
